MVP Builder (part-time contract)

Company: Loomline (indie SaaS)

We are building an MVP for a small workflow product and need a part-time builder.

- Python (FastAPI) + React + Postgres
- You will build features end-to-end: schema to UI
- Ship bi-weekly releases

Contract: B2B, 15 h/week, $1,800 per month
Remote: async-first, 2h daily overlap with CET
No exclusivity; open to subcontracting parts of the work
Application: mvp@loomline.example

evidence_spans.subcontracting_policy: open to subcontracting parts of the work

notes: Edge case: rate $1,800 < $2,000 floor; hours 15/week > allow_below_floor_if_hours_leq (10) so the exception does NOT apply -> hard reject on compensation.
